dedupe_keys.name: ergnss spanish national network of gnss reference stations ign

description: ERGNSS, the Spanish national geodetic network of GNSS reference stations run by the Instituto Geográfico Nacional, has more than 120 permanent GPS/GNSS stations distributed across Spain, many of them part of the European EUREF network and some part of the worldwide IGS network. The page lists every station with its location, national identifier, a station sheet in PDF and a site log, marks which stations belong to IGS and EUREF, and links a viewer of the stations; IGN also runs a real-time positioning service. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): IGN licence of use compatible with CC-BY-4.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the page documents the stations, not serving the observation files, which are reached through IGN and EUREF services, and it is in Spanish. Coverage is Spain. It supports positioning infrastructure studies and the monitoring of space weather effects on GNSS; related records are the SAPOS service of Germany and the OS Net network of Great Britain.
